selection_basis: validation pooled NDCG@5, then P@5, then lexical

reviewer.rating_basis: Authored contextual judgements from student profiles and vacancy descriptions/requirements. Requirement-focused evidence excerpts were used; not an exhaustive human audit of every description. No main-sheet method/rank/split used to assign labels. Unverified location, GPA, equipment and citizenship were kept unknown; explicit unmet mandatory qualifications marked ineligible.

limits: Single AI-assisted judgement set, not independent human ground truth
12 fictional profiles; six validation and six held-out test profiles
Pooled NDCG uses union of both top-five lists, not full catalogue
Historical jobs: relevance is separate from current eligibility and availability
Method choice is provisional pending representative human validation
